seo.title: Richmond, VA RV Rental Market
seo.description: Richmond, VA RV rental prices: median $125/night across 99 Outdoorsy & RVshare listings. Live market benchmarks for hosts.
seo.introHtml:
Richmond, VA RV rental hosts currently compete across 99 active listings on Outdoorsy and RVshare within a 35-mile radius. The median asking rate is $125/night (average $157), a $32 premium of the mean over the median that signals how skewed high-end inventory is.

Platform mix is roughly 35% Outdoorsy / 65% RVshare (35 vs 64). By class: Travel Trailer median $115 (67 listings); Fifth Wheel median $163 (11 listings); Class C median $211 (8 listings). 73% of listings offer delivery; 22% are instant book.

Figures are computed from active geo-scoped listings with a positive nightly rate. Use this page as a pricing baseline, then refine against comps in your class, length, and amenity bundle.

faq.question: What is the average RV rental rate in Richmond?
faq.answer: The average asking rate in Richmond, VA is $157 per night; the median is $125 (P25 $110 · P75 $172) across 99 active listings.

faq.question: How many RV rentals are listed in Richmond?
faq.answer: RVIntel currently tracks 99 active listings in the Richmond, VA market window (35 mi): 35 on Outdoorsy and 64 on RVshare.

faq.question: Is Outdoorsy or RVshare larger in Richmond?
faq.answer: RVshare currently has more inventory in Richmond, VA (64 vs 35 on Outdoorsy). Many hosts list on both.
